name: Crusoe Energy Systems (Crusoe AI)
monetization: Designs, builds, and operates energy-first AI datacenter campuses (builder of Stargate Abilene) and sells GPU cloud capacity; monetizes power access as the scarce input.
description_md: Crusoe is a Denver-based, vertically integrated AI-infrastructure company — from power generation to datacenter shells to Crusoe Cloud — that began in flared-gas bitcoin mining and pivoted fully to AI (selling its bitcoin business in 2025). It is the builder of the flagship Stargate campus in Abilene, Texas for OpenAI/Oracle (~1.2GW, developed through a $15B JV with Blue Owl Capital and Primary Digital Infrastructure), and broke ground in Mar 2026 on an adjacent ~900MW campus for Microsoft, taking the combined Abilene footprint to ~2.1GW. The company reports contracts for nearly 5GW of computing power and a >40GW project pipeline, with customers including OpenAI (via Oracle), Microsoft, Meta, Oracle and Google. In Jul 2026 it was reported in talks to raise ~$3B at a ~$30B valuation — roughly triple its ~$10B mark of late 2025 (UNVERIFIED; not closed).
ai_monetization_md: Three stacked revenue models: (1) **Development/build fees and JV economics** on mega-campuses — the Abilene JV (Blue Owl/Primary Digital, $15B across two phases, financed with JPMorgan-led construction loans of $2.3B and $7.1B) pays Crusoe as developer-operator while capital partners hold the assets; (2) **Long-term capacity leases** to hyperscalers/labs (Oracle leases Abilene for OpenAI under Stargate; Microsoft anchor-tenants the second campus); (3) **Crusoe Cloud** GPU-as-a-service on its own power-advantaged sites. The energy-first model (behind-the-meter gas, stranded power, fast interconnects) turns time-to-power — the sector's binding constraint — into its margin.
ai_strategy_md: Own the power bottleneck rather than the GPUs: acquire sites with multi-hundred-MW power access, build at record speed (Abilene phase 1 energized ~12 months from groundbreaking), and let investment-grade capital (Blue Owl, Primary Digital, bank construction loans) own the shells while Crusoe keeps development margin and operations. Scale the pipeline (>40GW) across Texas and beyond, diversify anchors beyond the OpenAI/Oracle complex (Microsoft campus, Google/Meta contracts), and grow Crusoe Cloud for margin capture. The reported ~$30B raise would fund the equity slices of new JVs.
risk_notes_md: **Valuation unverified:** the ~$30B figure is from Jul 2026 press reports of an in-progress raise (~$3B) with no final terms, lead, or close disclosed — recorded at low confidence, explicitly UNVERIFIED. **Anchor concentration:** the economics of the flagship campuses trace to OpenAI (via Oracle's Stargate lease) and Microsoft; an OpenAI demand shortfall propagates through Oracle's lease to the Abilene JV's $9.4B of construction debt (see contagion framework, SPEC §10.3b). **Structure opacity:** as a private developer, Crusoe's own retained exposure vs the JV partners' (residual value, completion guarantees) is not publicly disclosed. **Execution:** simultaneous multi-GW builds strain turbine, transformer, and electrical-labor bottlenecks (see bottleneck registry).
